summary: ralexstokes 发文主张谨慎控制 Glamsterdam 范围，为 2026 打好基础。nero_eth 认为 Glamsterdam 已有 ePBS 与 BAL，再加 FOCIL 会过于复杂；donnoh_eth 建议把抗审查作为下一分叉主题。ERC-7730 增加信任假设章节，合并。zeam 合并 XMSS 后量子签名。

items.title: Magicians：交付有影响力的 2026
items.note: （ralexstokes）07:41：Fusaka 即将上线，主张慢慢增加范围，以平稳换取速度；nero_eth：Glamsterdam 已有 ePBS 与 BAL，现在加入 FOCIL 可能难以安全按时交付 14:18；donnoh_eth：Glamsterdam 保持 L1 扩容主题，下一分叉以抗审查为主题 09:46。
items.note_en: (ralexstokes), 07:41: with Fusaka imminent, add scope slowly, trading haste for smoothness; nero_eth: Glamsterdam already has ePBS and BAL, so adding FOCIL now risks safe and timely delivery, 14:18; donnoh_eth: keep L1 scaling as Glamsterdam's theme and make the next fork about censorship resistance, 09:46.

keywords_en: the debate over FOCIL in Glamsterdam
summary_en: ralexstokes argued for careful Glamsterdam scoping to set up 2026. nero_eth said Glamsterdam already has ePBS and BAL so adding FOCIL is too complex; donnoh_eth suggested censorship resistance as the next fork's theme. ERC-7730 gained a trust assumptions section, merged. zeam merged XMSS post-quantum signatures.
